title: Field signal cartographer and prioritization trellis for enterprise asks
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Sales and Customer Success submit enterprise feature asks through multiple channels (Slack, Zendesk, forms, calls). We lack a lightweight, repeatable aggregation and initial scoping pattern that captures the signal (who asked, usage context, econ sketch) and produces a handoff artifact for PM/Eng/DSE. This causes variable first responses, duplicate work, and slow prioritization.

Objective: Create a repeatable artifact and runbook — the 'Signal Cartographer' — plus a compact prioritization matrix (the 'Prioritization Trellis') to standardize first-pass scoping for non-bug enterprise feature requests. The outcome should reduce time-to-first-scope, improve signal fidelity for engineering estimations, and surface high-impact asks faster to Roadmap and Sales leadership.
background: Current intake efforts have many macros and templates but lack consistent fields for: estimated seat count, revenue proxy, integration complexity, data residency constraints, and regulatory sensitivity. Several enterprise asks historically stalled during PM triage due to missing cost/econ context. CS reports that follow-up clarification takes on average 6 business days. We want an approach that fits into an SDR/AE/CS 10-minute intake conversation and produces a 15-minute scoping artifact for PM review.
proposal:
Deliver a lightweight form + auto-generated initial-scope doc that lives in a shared workspace: fields are request summary, business trigger, expected customer volume, example workflows, rough success metrics, must-have constraints (SLA/data residency), and a 3-line economic proxy (ARR uplift / cost to build). Build a 1-page template output and a scoring function (Prioritization Trellis) that ranks asks by: business impact, technical complexity, revenue signal, and implementation risk. Pilot with two AE pods and two CS teams for 4 weeks.

Deliverables: (1) Signal Cartographer form & template (Confluence + quick Slack button flow), (2) Prioritization Trellis scoring sheet (Google Sheets + scoring macros), (3) Runbook for Sales/CS and PM handoff, (4) Dashboard to surface top-20 active asks for PM weekly review.

acceptance_criteria: Pilot completed with at least 8 unique asks submitted via the Cartographer
Median time from ask submission to PM-first-scope reduced to <=2 business days
All pilot asks have complete econ sketch and at least one assigned follow-up owner (PM or Solutions Eng)
Prioritization Trellis ranks pilot asks and top 5 are accepted for deeper scoping or backlog grooming
success_metrics: % of asks with completed econ proxy at first submission
Number of duplicate asks merged by the Cartographer
CS/AE satisfaction score for intake flow (post-pilot survey)
# of asks promoted to backlog per month
